title: Ai Comes to the Yozakura Family / Mini Kyoichiro
overview: Former Tanpopo executive Ai joins the Yozakura household to reform, but peace is soon threatened.

title: Winners and Losers
overview: Taiyo faces school chaos as Bronze Rank spy Sosuke Michibata targets him with sabotage and rumors.

title: The Big Bro Shinzo Safety Watch Team
overview: Shinzo’s shopping trip with Ayaka turns chaotic as Kengo and Nanao secretly assist him.

title: Spy Advancement Exam
overview: Taiyo faces Shinzo in a brutal game of tag during the first stage of the Spy Exam.

title: The Fruit of Love
overview: Taiyo faces Kyoichiro in a terrifying final exam stage where examinees vanish into the darkness.

title: New Cherry Blossoms
overview: Taiyo meets a mutated Kawashita to learn how to kill Tsubomi, but his father-in-law, Momo, appears.

title: At the Old Yozakura Residence
overview: Mutsumi tests Taiyo’s surging powers while Futaba fails to learn tech skills from Shion.

title: Ai's Errand / Mutsumi's Major Diet Mission
overview: Ai goes on her first solo errand to cheer up the family, while a disguised Taiyo and Mutsumi follow.

title: Tsubomi & Mutsumi
overview: The Yozakuras' search for an ancient journal turns into a chaotic and revealing mansion cleanup.

title: Refusal
overview: Kyoichiro vanishes, but Taiyo’s date is cut short by a mysterious presence and an urgent summons.

title: Operation Search for the Eldest Son
overview: Taiyo finds Kyoichiro, who rejects the family and flees, causing a rift among the siblings.

title: Let's Be a Family Again
overview: Poisoned by Tsubomi, Kyoichiro flees to save his family. Taiyo desperately chases him to save him.

title: Family Restaurant Meeting With Dad
overview: Momo vanishes after revealing his plot. Kyoichiro returns home to face a punishing family day.

title: The Gold Rank Spy Meeting
overview: Momo escapes despite Taiyo and Kyoichiro's pursuit, and Kyoichiro is summoned by Kai Izumo.

title: Objectives
overview: Taiyo and the spies race against time to stop shapeshifters from bombing HQ.

title: Making Soba Noodles
overview: The Yozakuras track their missing siblings and face hostile spies at a local mall.

title: Mission: Sibling Retrieval
overview: Shion has successfully booted the upgraded mass biometric analytical  system for locating Momo Yozakura, Old Man Hunter 2. While she searches, Taiyo attempts to take his skills to the next level so that he can hold his own against Momo. Thanks to Kyoichiro's spartan training and Kai's support, Taiyo discovers his own way of fighting while manifesting Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers. Just then, Shion reports that she's pinpointed Momo's location! The Yozakuras and the Gold Rank spies mobilize to bring Futaba and Shinzo home!

title: Yozakura Family Feud
overview: Kengo and Taiyo face off against the brainwashed Shinzo in a basement-level hallway of the Kaioumaru. As Shinzo's fighting seriously, now that he's activated his Blooming, they're purely on the defensive, but when they spot an opening, they try to contain him. Kengo uses his Blooming technique, Assimilation, to reverse the mind control by entering Shinzo's memories. There, he finds the walls plastered with fun-filled memories of Shinzo spending time with the family. As he advances further, he finds Shinzo's more recent memories, redacted by Momo, and Shinzo himself, staring at the monitor with lifeless eyes.

title: Dreams
overview: Waking up to an ordinary, blissful morning with the family that is no longer with him, Taiyo almost gives in to the deception, even while feeling that something's off. That's when sakura blossoms suddenly start blooming on his hands... When he comes to, Taiyo finds himself trapped by a tentacle growing out of an ominous, giant black sakura tree. Shinzo and Kengo have also been caught, and they're unconscious. And now he's lost contact with Mutsumi and the other siblings! Kai and the other Gold Rank spies can only stand by, unsure of what's going on. To rescue everyone, Taiyo rushes off to find Momo!
